findings.evidence: api.py:149-157 runs check_chapter_async under a fresh asyncio.run (worker thread when a loop is running) on every call, so caller-supplied async llm/typesafe_client/role_llms reused across calls or created on the caller's loop get driven on a foreign or closed loop; failures then surface as swallowed errors (hollow.py:107-111 returns []). Docstring at api.py:129 promises loop safety. P1 is high; check_chapter_async is the escape hatch.
findings.message: ghostcopyeditor/api.py:154–158 — Async callers passing loop-bound clients can fail when check_chapter runs their work on a new event loop. Failure: client requests may raise a different-loop error or hang.
